newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTTEP falls 8.98 pct on lower reserves.
newsitem.headline: PTTEP falls 8.98 pct on lower reserves.

text.p: Shares of state-backed Thai oil firm PTT Exploration and Production Plc fell 8.98 percent on Tuesday after the company lowered its estimate of reserves in the Bongkot field, analysts said.
The shares, which topped the actives list, fell 30 baht to 304 by 0406 GMT. The composite SET Index had gained 0.34 percent over the same period.

The company's stock fell the maximum 10 percent daily trading floor limit on Monday, after the firm revised down its estimates of reserves in the Bongkot field, in which it has a 40 percent stake, to 2.8 trillion cubic feet from 3.1 trillion.
